context.text: This is an open seat. Incumbent Thomas Tiffany (R) did not seek re-election to this district in 2026. Fred Clark defeated Ginger Murray and Chris Armstrong in the Democratic primary. Michael Alfonso defeated Kevin Hermening, Jessi Ebben, Niina Threlfall-Baum, and Donald Raihala in the Republican primary.

candidates.name: Fred Clark
candidates.ballotNote: Defeated Ginger Murray and Chris Armstrong in the Democratic primary.
candidates.currentRole: Owner, Clark Forestry, Inc.; former Wisconsin State Assembly member

summary.text: Fred Clark is a forester and small-business owner who represented Wisconsin State Assembly District 81 from 2009 to 2015. He is the Democratic nominee for the open 7th Congressional District and completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 1985 and a master's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1992.
Owns Clark Forestry, Inc.; previously worked as a service forester/consultant with the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources and as a forest ecologist for The Nature Conservancy.
Served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing District 81, from 2009 to 2015.

priorities.text: Says elected representatives should represent everyone, not billionaires and elites whose influence he says captures politicians of both parties, and calls for setting aside old partisanship.
Says he is personally passionate about conservation, public lands, small businesses, and Congressional oversight.

record.text: Served on the Wisconsin Assembly's Education, Environment and Forestry, Jobs Economy and Mining, and Natural Resources and Sporting Heritage committees during the 2013-2014 legislative session.

candidates.name: Michael Alfonso
candidates.ballotNote: Defeated Kevin Hermening, Jessi Ebben, Niina Threlfall-Baum, and Donald Raihala in the Republican primary.

summary.text: Michael Alfonso is a University of Wisconsin-Madison mathematics graduate who has worked in the construction and concrete industries and produced a political podcast. He is the Republican nominee for the open 7th Congressional District.

background.text: Received a bachelor's degree in mathematics from the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
Professional experience includes working in the construction and concrete industries and producing the podcast The Dan Bongino Show.

candidates.researchNotes: Alfonso has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, and no working campaign website with policy statements was found as of the research date.
